# ivreg2r

Instrumental variables and GMM estimation for R with built-in
diagnostics, designed to reproduce Stata’s
[`ivreg2`](https://ideas.repec.org/c/boc/bocode/s425401.html) output
(Baum, Schaffer & Stillman, 2003, 2007).

> **Note:** This package is not yet on CRAN. It is an independent
> reimplementation, not affiliated with or endorsed by the original
> `ivreg2` authors. Version 0.1.0. Requires R \>= 4.4.0.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("restatr/ivreg2r")
```

## Example

``` r

library(ivreg2r)
data(card)

fit <- ivreg2(lwage ~ exper + expersq + black + smsa + south + smsa66 +
                reg662 + reg663 + reg664 + reg665 + reg666 + reg667 +
                reg668 + reg669 | educ | nearc2 + nearc4,
              data = card, vcov = "robust", small = TRUE)
summary(fit)
#> 
#> 2SLS Estimation
#> 
#> Call:
#> ivreg2(formula = lwage ~ exper + expersq + black + smsa + south + 
#>     smsa66 + reg662 + reg663 + reg664 + reg665 + reg666 + reg667 + 
#>     reg668 + reg669 | educ | nearc2 + nearc4, data = card, vcov = "robust", 
#>     small = TRUE)
#> 
#> Observations: 3,010 
#> VCV type:     Robust, small-sample corrected 
#> 
#> Coefficients:
#>               Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
#> (Intercept)  3.2367114  0.8842788   3.660 0.000256 ***
#> educ         0.1570593  0.0525525   2.989 0.002825 ** 
#> exper        0.1188149  0.0229516   5.177 2.41e-07 ***
#> expersq     -0.0023565  0.0003684  -6.397 1.83e-10 ***
#> black       -0.1232779  0.0516278  -2.388 0.017010 *  
#> smsa         0.1007530  0.0314458   3.204 0.001369 ** 
#> south       -0.1431945  0.0302678  -4.731 2.34e-06 ***
#> smsa66       0.0150626  0.0211683   0.712 0.476792    
#> reg662       0.1027473  0.0379324   2.709 0.006793 ** 
#> reg663       0.1499316  0.0371230   4.039 5.51e-05 ***
#> reg664       0.0475676  0.0456953   1.041 0.297972    
#> reg665       0.1544801  0.0509365   3.033 0.002444 ** 
#> reg666       0.1729728  0.0535430   3.231 0.001249 ** 
#> reg667       0.1420355  0.0523988   2.711 0.006753 ** 
#> reg668      -0.0950611  0.0587578  -1.618 0.105801    
#> reg669       0.1029760  0.0426891   2.412 0.015915 *  
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1
#> ---
#> R-squared:      0.1702 
#> Adj. R-squared: 0.1660 
#> F(15, 2994):     51.4 (p < 2.2e-16)
#> Root MSE:       0.4053 
#> 
#> Weak identification test:
#>   Cragg-Donald Wald F:           7.89 
#>   Kleibergen-Paap rk Wald F:     8.32 
#>   (Stock-Yogo critical values are for iid errors)
#>   Stock-Yogo critical values (IV size):
#>      10%  maximal IV size       19.93 
#>      15%  maximal IV size       11.59 
#>      20%  maximal IV size       8.75 
#>      25%  maximal IV size       7.25 
#> 
#> Underidentification test (Kleibergen-Paap rk LM statistic):
#>   Chi-sq(2) = 16.37 (p = 0.0003)
#> 
#> Weak-instrument-robust inference:
#>   H0: B1=0 and orthogonality conditions are valid
#>   Anderson-Rubin Wald F(2,2993) = 5.28 (p = 0.0051)
#>   Anderson-Rubin Wald Chi-sq(2) = 10.63 (p = 0.0049)
#>   Stock-Wright LM S Chi-sq(2) = 10.61 (p = 0.0050)
#> 
#> Overidentification test (Hansen J):
#>   Chi-sq(1) = 1.27 (p = 0.2600)
#> 
#> Endogeneity test:
#>   Chi-sq(1) = 2.83 (p = 0.0925)
#>   Tested: educ
#> 
#> First-stage diagnostics:
#>   Endogenous        F-stat   p-value  Partial R2  Shea PR2      SW F      AP F
#>   educ                8.32    0.0002      0.0052    0.0052      8.32      8.32
#> 
#> Instrumented:          educ 
#> Included instruments:  exper, expersq, black, smsa, south, smsa66, reg662, reg663, reg664, reg665, reg666, reg667, reg668, reg669 
#> Excluded instruments:  nearc2, nearc4
```

Extract results programmatically with broom:

``` r

tidy(fit)
```

## Formula syntax

Three-part formula: `y ~ exogenous | endogenous | excluded_instruments`.
Each variable appears once; exogenous regressors are automatically
included as instruments.

| Part    | Contents              | Example                                |
|---------|-----------------------|----------------------------------------|
| LHS     | Dependent variable    | `lwage`                                |
| 1st RHS | Exogenous regressors  | `exper + expersq + black + smsa + ...` |
| 2nd RHS | Endogenous regressors | `educ`                                 |
| 3rd RHS | Excluded instruments  | `nearc2 + nearc4`                      |

A one-part formula (`y ~ x1 + x2`) estimates OLS.

## Features

**Estimators:** OLS, 2SLS, LIML, Fuller, k-class, two-step efficient
GMM, CUE

**Standard errors:** classical, robust, one- and two-way clustering,
HAC/AC (8 kernels), Kiefer, Driscoll-Kraay, cluster+kernel

**Diagnostics:** weak identification (Kleibergen-Paap rk, Cragg-Donald,
Stock-Yogo critical values), underidentification, overidentification
(Sargan, Hansen J), endogeneity, first-stage F/partial R-squared,
Anderson-Rubin, Stock-Wright S, orthogonality, redundancy

**Integration:**
[`tidy()`](https://generics.r-lib.org/reference/tidy.html),
[`glance()`](https://generics.r-lib.org/reference/glance.html),
[`augment()`](https://generics.r-lib.org/reference/augment.html) via
[broom](https://broom.tidymodels.org/)

All estimators and diagnostics are tested against Stata `ivreg2`
benchmarks.

## Stata migration

Common translations (see
[`vignette("introduction")`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/articles/introduction.md)
for the [full
table](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/articles/introduction.html#stata-migration-quick-reference)
and [intentional
differences](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/articles/introduction.html#intentional-differences-from-stata)):

| Stata | R (`ivreg2r`) |
|----|----|
| `ivreg2 y x (endo = z1 z2)` | `ivreg2(y ~ x \| endo \| z1 + z2, data = d)` |
| `ivreg2 ..., robust` | `ivreg2(..., vcov = "robust")` |
| `ivreg2 ..., robust small` | `ivreg2(..., vcov = "robust", small = TRUE)` |
| `ivreg2 ..., cluster(g)` | `ivreg2(..., clusters = ~ g)` |
| `ivreg2 ..., cluster(g) small` | `ivreg2(..., clusters = ~ g, small = TRUE)` |
| `ivreg2 ..., liml` | `ivreg2(..., method = "liml")` |
| `ivreg2 ..., gmm2s` | `ivreg2(..., method = "gmm2s")` |

## Learn more

- [`vignette("introduction")`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/articles/introduction.md)
  — OLS, 2SLS, diagnostics, robust/cluster SEs, weights, broom
  integration, Stata migration reference
- [`vignette("advanced-iv")`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/articles/advanced-iv.md)
  — LIML, Fuller, k-class, COVIV, two-way clustering, reduced-form,
  model comparison
- [`vignette("time-series-gmm")`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/articles/time-series-gmm.md)
  — HAC/AC, Kiefer, Driscoll-Kraay, GMM, CUE, partialling, user matrices

``` r
  Baum C, Schaffer M, Stillman S (2003). "Instrumental Variables and
  GMM: Estimation and Testing." _The Stata Journal_, *3*(1), 1-31.
  doi:10.1177/1536867X0300300101

bibtex=TRUE)', 'toBibtex(.)', or set
'options(citation.bibtex.max=999)'.
```

# Package index

## Estimation

Fit models, summarize them, and inspect the first stage.

- [`ivreg2()`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/ivreg2.md) :
  Extended Instrumental Variables Estimation
- [`summary(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/summary.ivreg2.md)
  : Summary for ivreg2 objects
- [`first_stage()`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/first_stage.md)
  : Extract first-stage regression objects

## Methods

S3 methods for fitted `ivreg2` objects.

- [`predict(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/predict.ivreg2.md)
  : Predict from an ivreg2 model
- [`coef(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/coef.ivreg2.md)
  : Extract coefficients from an ivreg2 object
- [`vcov(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/vcov.ivreg2.md)
  : Extract variance-covariance matrix from an ivreg2 object
- [`confint(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/confint.ivreg2.md)
  : Confidence intervals for ivreg2 coefficients
- [`fitted(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/fitted.ivreg2.md)
  : Extract fitted values from an ivreg2 object
- [`residuals(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/residuals.ivreg2.md)
  : Extract residuals from an ivreg2 object
- [`nobs(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/nobs.ivreg2.md)
  : Extract number of observations from an ivreg2 object
- [`formula(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/formula.ivreg2.md)
  : Extract formula from an ivreg2 object
- [`model.matrix(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/model.matrix.ivreg2.md)
  : Extract design matrices from an ivreg2 model
- [`terms(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/terms.ivreg2.md)
  : Extract terms object from an ivreg2 model
- [`update(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/update.ivreg2.md)
  : Update and re-fit an ivreg2 model
- [`print(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/print.ivreg2.md)
  : Print an ivreg2 object
- [`print(`*`<summary.ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/print.summary.ivreg2.md)
  : Print a summary.ivreg2 object

## broom methods

tidy(), glance(), and augment() for tidyverse workflows.

- [`tidy(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/tidy.ivreg2.md)
  : Tidy an ivreg2 object
- [`glance(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/glance.ivreg2.md)
  : Glance at an ivreg2 object
- [`augment(`*`<ivreg2>`*`)`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/augment.ivreg2.md)
  : Augment data with ivreg2 model predictions and residuals
- [`reexports`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/reexports.md)
  [`tidy`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/reexports.md)
  [`glance`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/reexports.md)
  [`augment`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/reexports.md) :
  Objects exported from other packages

## Formula operators

Lag and difference operators for time-series and panel instruments.

- [`l()`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/ts-operators.md)
  [`d()`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/ts-operators.md) :
  Time-series operators for ivreg2 formulas

## Datasets

Datasets used throughout the help-file examples and vignettes.

- [`abdata`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/abdata.md) :
  Arellano–Bond (1991) UK Employment Panel

- [`card`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/card.md) : Card (1995)
  College Proximity Dataset

- [`cigar`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/cigar.md) : Cigarette
  Demand Panel (Baltagi–Levin / Baltagi–Griffin–Xiong)

- [`griliches`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/griliches.md) :
  Griliches (1976) Young Men's Wages Dataset

- [`grunfeld`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/grunfeld.md) :
  Grunfeld (1958) Corporate Investment Panel

- [`klein`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/klein.md) :
  Klein (1950) Model I Macroeconomic Data

- [`mroz`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/mroz.md) : Mroz (1987)
  Female Labor Supply Dataset

- [`nlswork`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/nlswork.md) :

  NLS Young Women Panel (Stata `[XT]` Manual Extract)

- [`phillips`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/phillips.md) :
  Phillips Curve Macroeconomic Dataset

- [`stockwatson`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/stockwatson.md)
  : Stock and Watson U.S. Macroeconomic Dataset

- [`wagepan`](https://restatr.com/ivreg2r/reference/wagepan.md) :
  Wooldridge Wage Panel Dataset
